children: Public Storage, through subsidiary PS Canada Finance ULC, completed an offering of C$400 million 4.540% senior notes due 2033 under an indenture with Computershare Trust Company as trustee. The notes, guaranteed by Public Storage and Public Storage Operating Company, pay interest semi-annually on March 16 and September 16, starting March 16, 2027, and mature on September 16, 2033. They are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations with make-whole redemption provisions, and may be redeemed at par on or after July 16, 2033. Covenants include limits on certain corporate transactions and leverage metrics tied to unencumbered assets.
